stem: A dentist is selecting a communicative guidance technique for a child who has a hearing disorder. Which approach is most consistent with current guidance?

options.text: Consider the child's cognitive and psychological development together with the communication deficit
Base the choice only on the hearing disorder and disregard the child's developmental level
Base the choice only on the child's cognitive development, treating the hearing disorder as irrelevant
Base the choice only on the child's psychological development, excluding other communication deficits
